name: ArgoCDAppSet
description: Manage Argo CD ApplicationSets, and preview the Applications they generate.
helpMarkDown:
[Documentation](https://github.com/WayneGoosen/azdo-argocd-tasks) | [Report an issue](https://github.com/WayneGoosen/azdo-argocd-tasks/issues)

Use **generate** in a pull request to show which Applications a change would add or remove.
author: WayneGoosen

options.generate: generate - preview the Applications it would produce
options.create: create - create or upsert from a manifest file

inputs.name: name
inputs.label: Name
inputs.visibleRule: command = get || command = delete || command = generate
inputs.helpMarkDown: ApplicationSet name. For **delete**, one per line; label selectors are not accepted.

inputs.name: manifestFile
inputs.label: Manifest file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to an ApplicationSet manifest. YAML or JSON; multi-document YAML is supported for **create**.

inputs.name: generateFrom
inputs.label: Generate from

options.file: file - a manifest in the repository
options.name: name - the ApplicationSet currently in the cluster

inputs.helpMarkDown: Preview a manifest before merging it, or preview what the live ApplicationSet would produce right now.

inputs.name: upsert
inputs.label: Upsert
inputs.helpMarkDown: Update the ApplicationSet if it already exists. This additionally requires `update` RBAC, not just `create`.

inputs.name: dryRun
inputs.label: Dry run
inputs.helpMarkDown: Validate without persisting, reporting what the ApplicationSet **would own**. To see the Applications it would **produce**, use the `generate` command instead.

inputs.name: projects
inputs.label: Projects
inputs.helpMarkDown: Limit to these projects, one per line.

inputs.name: selector
inputs.label: Label selector
inputs.helpMarkDown: Kubernetes label selector. Not accepted for delete.

inputs.name: confirm
inputs.label: Confirm deletion
inputs.helpMarkDown: **Required for delete.** Deleting an ApplicationSet also deletes every Application it generated, unless `preserveResourcesOnDeletion` is set on the ApplicationSet.

inputs.name: appsetNamespace
inputs.label: ApplicationSet namespace
inputs.helpMarkDown: Namespace holding the ApplicationSet, for appsets-in-any-namespace installs.

inputs.name: artifactName
inputs.label: Artifact name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name of the published artifact carrying the full generated Applications. Defaults to `argocd-generated-apps`.

outputVariables.name: appSetCount
outputVariables.description: Number of ApplicationSets listed or created.

outputVariables.name: generatedApps
outputVariables.description: Compact JSON array of generated Applications: name, namespace, project, server.

outputVariables.name: generatedAppsFile
outputVariables.description: Path to the full generated Application objects.

outputVariables.name: deletedCount
outputVariables.description: Number of ApplicationSets whose deletion was requested.
